description: List the code segments (functions and blocks) extracted from one scan's JavaScript, each with location, length, snippet and hashes; script_url narrows to one file, paginated with limit and offset. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 100; omit for the API's default.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

script_url.description: Only segments from this script URL.
script_url.title: Script Url

name: get_js_segments_by_scan
title: Get JS Segments By Scan
